pick.headline: Administration Vows to Crush Fraud, Locates All Savings in One Insurance Program
pick.take: The new regulation promises to crush fraudsters, and the projected savings come entirely from Medicare Advantage. Either fraud lives in one program, or the accounting does. We'd like to see the differential diagnosis, but the plans are unlikely to code for it.
